name: ddaro
description: ddaro - worktree-based parallel workflow plugin (self-hosted marketplace)

plugins.name: ddaro
plugins.description: Worktree-per-session git workflow for parallel Claude Code sessions: isolated worktree + branch per session, deletion-aware commits with automatic context snapshots, PR merges driven through CI, crash recovery, protective hooks (main protection, branch naming). Per-command instruction files keep token use low.
